styleAndGeometry.geometryGuide: Controls camera, silhouette, proportions, contact points, room placement and attachments only.
styleAndGeometry.visualStyle: Detailed illustrated pixel art with layered shading, material texture, crisp pixel clusters and dark pixel outlines.
styleAndGeometry.referenceUse: Supplied images guide illustration detail only. Their room contents, color palette, characters and composition are not reused.

assembly.appearanceAndPhysicalSize: Each product family has five individually measured price-tier sprites; the prototype selects one tier per family. Ten decor families also have five tiers each.
assembly.rendering: Transparent sprites preserve their aspect ratio. Furniture aligns to measured floor contacts, wall decor to its wall plane, and mounted accessories to parent-local attachment points.
attachments: TV and support feet are a separate purchasable sprite attached at the center of the selected TV-bench top; it moves with bench height and position.
PC tower is a separate purchasable sprite attached at the rear-right desk-top slot; monitor and keyboard remain within the desk sprite.
Desk-top decor attaches to a local tabletop slot. Wall decor mounts to the measured right-wall plane and replaces the other right-wall items during preview.
Hi-fi system, plant and nightstand share one optional floor slot between bed and desk; the hi-fi uses the clear strip along the right wall to keep its side speakers visible past the sofa.
assembly.light: Neutral fixed room light; no evening sun or per-sprite light source.
assembly.bedTierComparison: Five measured silhouettes share the same 95 x 200 cm footprint; prices are provisional prototype values, not retail prices, and are not connected to game data.
assembly.sofaOrientation: Both sofa variants face -u toward the TV; neither has block-like details on its back or armrests.
assembly.priceData: Prototype prices in item-catalog.js and bed-price-ladder.js are illustrative, not retail prices, and are not connected to game economy data.
